ḥr.known: ḥr — face; (preposition) upon, on, over, concerning
used here as: Horus, the falcon god, son of Osiris and Isis; the sun as a falcon (god's name; Budge: Ḥeru)
day (noun; the sun sign with its stroke)

nḥm.known: nḥm — to take away, carry off, snatch
used here as: to rescue, save (from) (verb; the same word as nḥm "take away")

ḥry-ib.known: ḥry-ib — middle, midst (noun; lit. "what is upon the heart"; m ḥry-ib "in the midst of")
used here as: midst; the inside, inner parts (of the body) (noun; lit. "what is upon the heart")

ḥmt.known: ḥmt — a wife, married woman · also woman in general (noun; plural ḥmwt "women")
used here as: Hemet, a place in the world below, written with the town sign (not otherwise known; Budge: Hemet)
field, marshland (noun; sḫt snḥmw "the Field of the Grasshoppers")

in.known: in — by (naming the agent, as in ḏd in N "said by N"); (particle) it is …
used here as: say, said (verb; only after the words quoted: in·sn "they say")

rd.known: rd — foot, leg (noun; dual rd·fy "his two feet")

used here as: land, earth (noun; dual tꜣwy "the Two Lands", Egypt; tp tꜣ "upon earth")
it, them (3rd person dependent pronoun, object of a verb; same spelling as st "place")
it, them (3rd person dependent pronoun, written s-t)

m.known: m — in, from (preposition) · also "with" (instrument), "as" (m bnw "as the Bennu"), "on" (living on), "by"; im before a suffix (im·i, im·f, im·tn)
used here as: what? (interrogative pronoun; r m "for what? why?")
